name: Oleyl erucate
description: Oleyl erucate (CAS 17673-56-2 ), also marketed under the trade name TEGOSOFT OER, is a fatty acid ester derived from erucic acid and oleyl alcohol. It functions as a lubricant, plasticizer, and emollient across industrial and personal care applications. This chemical offers low-viscosity performance with high thermal stability for demanding environments. In metalworking and industrial lubrication, it is used as a base fluid or additive in cutting oils and forming lubricants. Its ester structure provides essential film-forming protection under pressure during heavy manufacturing. Personal care formulators incorporate it into skin creams, hair conditioners, and color cosmetics as a lightweight emollient. The product spreads evenly without leaving a greasy residue on the skin or hair. In plastics processing, it acts as an internal or external plasticizer and slip agent in polymer films and compounds, improving flexibility. It also enhances surface release and supports emulsification in formulated lubricant concentrates. This is particularly useful in metalworking fluids where stable oil-in-water dispersion is required for cooling and lubrication. Oleyl erucate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid for various industrial uses. It is available in technical grade for industrial lubrication and polymer applications to ensure consistent performance. It is also offered in cosmetic grade meeting purity standards required by personal care manufacturers.
